edge_sample.source_text: theorem : There is no 5-parameter pose that makes the noperthedron have the Rupert property.
edge_sample.target_text: proof : Suppose there were a purely rotational pose. Then convert that to an equivalent 5-parameter pose with Theorem~\ref{thm:pose_of_matrix_pose} and appeal to Theorem~\ref{thm:no_nopert_pose}.
